reference.code: use std::collections::{HashMap,HashSet};fn ck(s:&str)->bool{let b=s.as_bytes();!b.is_empty()&&b[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&b.iter().all(|x|x.is_ascii_lowercase()||x.is_ascii_digit()||*x==b'-')&&!s.ends_with('-')&&!s.contains("--")}pub fn order_changes(a:&[[&str;3]])->Option<Vec<String>>{let mut d=HashMap::new();for x in a{if !ck(x[0])||(x[1]!="-"&&!ck(x[1]))||x[0]==x[1]{return None}let q:i32=x[2].parse().ok()?;if q<0||q>10000000||q.to_string()!=x[2]||d.insert(x[0],(x[1],q)).is_some(){return None}}if d.values().any(|x|x.0!="-"&&!d.contains_key(x.0)){return None}let(mut o,mut z)=(vec![],HashSet::new());while o.len()<d.len(){let mut r:Vec<_>=d.iter().filter(|(n,x)|!z.contains(**n)&&(x.0=="-"||z.contains(x.0))).map(|(n,x)|(x.1,*n)).collect();r.sort();let n=r.first()?.1;z.insert(n);o.push(n.into())}Some(o)}
